lines.say: Zero model calls. / That's how this framework / replays what / an AI agent did.

shots.sub: model calls when a step replays

lines.say: It's called e2e, / an end-to-end testing framework / for web / and mobile apps.
You write a goal / in natural language, / like: upgrade the workspace / to the Pro plan.
An agent drives / the app to reach it. / Then you check / the result / in plain words / and with a locator.
Here's the trick. / Once a later check / confirms the step, / e2e records / the agent's actions. / The next run / replays them / without the model. / If the app changed, / the agent takes over.
Tests without agent steps / need no model. / Bring your own subscription, / API key, / or local model.
It drives Chromium, / Firefox and WebKit / through Playwright, / plus iOS simulators / and Android emulators.
3,788 people / have starred it. / It's still on the way / to 1.0.
To start, / run npx e2e init. / It asks / for an engine / and a model provider, / then writes a config / and an example test.
The examples cover / Vite, Next.js, / Expo and SwiftUI, / each with a passing suite.
e2e, by TesterArmy. / Open source / under Apache 2.0.
